title: Nano Machine
altTitles: Nano Machine: I Have a Nanomachine
description: Cheon Yeo-Woon, the illegitimate seventh son of the leader of the Demonic Cult, has lived under constant threat and discrimination because he cannot properly learn martial arts. His life changes when a mysterious descendant from the future appears and injects a powerful nanomachine into his body. With the nanomachine enhancing his physical abilities, analyzing martial arts, and providing advanced technological assistance, Yeo-Woon begins his journey to overcome the powerful clans of the Demonic Cult and rise to the top.
author: Hanjung Wolya / Jeolmu Hyeon / GGBG
